A repêchage after Gold and Silver, open to a Silver boat because the medal races carry nothing

(constructed) 2026 — A split-fleet championship with a repêchage for the last medal seat · F9

1 qualifying fleets · → Gold/Silver · discards: No discards. · medal race ×1
The repêchage need not follow a qualifying series: here it follows Gold
and Silver, for the last seat in a three-boat medal fleet. The medal races
carry nothing in, so a Silver boat may sail it: no Silver score is ever
set against a Gold one. (Where the medal stage carries a score, only Gold
boats could — see `repechagePool`.)

One qualifying fleet of six, split into Gold s1-s3 and Silver s4-s6, one
final race each. s1 and s2 are selected directly; s3 (Gold) and s4
(Silver) sail a one-race repêchage, which s4 wins and is promoted from.

The medal race decides the championship alone: s4, s1, s2. s4 is still a
Silver boat — her final fleet does not change — but she ranks in the medal
fleet. The others keep their net score: s3 3+3+3 in Gold, then Silver
s5 5+5+2 and s6 6+6+3.
